why: an RCL3 colony with no storage banks its outposts' haul on the pile at its hub's centre and spends it as it comes: Strategy declares its neighbour, the neighbour nets, and decay takes a small share of the dig, fitted from the first outpost dig (main works no outpost before the storage; with upgraders ranked before the outposts' haul on any stock, the source containers' too, 33% decayed at the outposts' containers; never before it, 13%; while the pile's draw outruns its decay, 10%; once the reserver could hold the outpost, its dig doubled and, the spend sized to dig no carrier brought home, 29% decayed; sized to the dig carried, 12%)
